query: select ar.ArtistId as id, ar.Name as artist, round(sum(l.UnitPrice*l.Quantity),2) as revenue from InvoiceLine l join Invoice i using(InvoiceId) join Track t using(TrackId) join Genre g using(GenreId) join Album al on al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId join Artist ar using(ArtistId) where (${year} is null or substr(i.InvoiceDate,1,4) = ${year}) and (${genre} is null or g.Name = ${genre}) group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc limit 10
